nodes.name: OrderCreatedEvent
nodes.description: Generated OrderCreatedEvent snapshot built by OrdersEventHandler from the saved order and published through the configured MessagingProvider.

nodes.name: OrderEntity before save
nodes.description: OrderEntity produced by OrderMapper.toOrderEntity; id and createdDate are ignored on input and remain unset until the save callback.

nodes.name: OrderEntity after save
nodes.description: OrderEntity returned by OrderRepository.save with UUID id and createdDate assigned by the BeforeConvertCallback.

nodes.name: ExistingOrder response
nodes.description: ExistingOrder JSON payload returned by POST /orders and used as each element of the GET /orders list.

nodes.name: GET /orders
nodes.description: HTTP GET /orders handled by OrderController.order(): returns all orders as ExistingOrder JSON.

nodes.name: POST /orders
nodes.description: HTTP POST /orders handled by OrderController.order(Order): accepts an Order JSON body and returns an ExistingOrder.

nodes.name: id
nodes.description: Null before save; generated by PersistenceConfig when the entity is converted.

nodes.name: Create order
nodes.description: POST /orders: map the Order payload to an OrderEntity, persist it, map the saved entity to an ExistingOrder response, and publish OrderCreatedEvent through the configured MessagingProvider.

nodes.name: List orders
nodes.description: GET /orders: read all persisted orders through OrderRepository and map each OrderEntity to an ExistingOrder response element.

nodes.name: Order request body
nodes.description: Wire Order JSON body received by POST /orders (web/payload.Order; OpenAPI Order schema).

nodes.name: After-commit event publishing
nodes.description: OrdersEventHandler.onOrderCreated is a @TransactionalEventListener, so OrderCreatedEvent is sent to the MessagingProvider after the transaction commits.

nodes.name: Messaging provider selection
nodes.description: retail.orders.messaging.provider selects the provider: in-memory by default, rabbitmq or sqs when configured; each config bean is gated by @ConditionalOnProperty.

nodes.name: Order id and created date generation
nodes.description: PersistenceConfig's BeforeConvertCallback assigns a random UUID id and current createdDate only when the incoming OrderEntity id is null.

nodes.name: Persistence provider selection
nodes.description: retail.orders.persistence.provider is 'in-memory' by default; the PostgreSQL DataSource bean is created only when it is set to 'postgres'.

nodes.name: SQS publish delay
nodes.description: When SQS is configured, SqsMessagingProvider serializes the event to JSON and sends it with delaySeconds(10).

nodes.name: Transactional create
nodes.description: OrderService.create is annotated @Transactional, so the repository save and the after-save event publication share one transaction boundary.

nodes.name: orders relational store
nodes.description: Spring Data JDBC tables orders, order_items and shipping_addresses; embedded H2 by default, PostgreSQL when configured.

edges.note: OrderRepository.save persists the aggregate into orders, shipping_addresses and order_items.
repository.save returns the persisted entity; the BeforeConvertCallback assigned id and createdDate beforehand.
repository.findAll() entities are mapped one-by-one with OrderMapper.toExistingOrder.
AfterSaveEvent -> postCreatedEvent copies entity.id and items into the generated Order/OrderCreatedEvent; onOrderCreated publishes it via MessagingProvider.
OrderMapper.toExistingOrder converts the saved OrderEntity to the ExistingOrder response payload.
OrderMapper.toOrderEntity copies shippingAddress/items via their mappers; id and createdDate are ignored on the incoming payload.
